messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly Renewal Snapshot + Mid-Quarter Churn Triage

Team,

Attached is a refreshed snapshot for the Atlas Mechanical renewal (Deal DEAL-2026-472). I pulled closed-loop usage + billing flags and added a churn-risk column based on 3 signals: 1) sys admin contacts dropped by >40% month-over-month, 2) discounts requested in last 30 days, and 3) open support escalations. Quick asks: 

- Rishi: please confirm the committed ARR and update stage if there's any shift from Commit -> Commit:AtRisk.
- Priyom: can you run the pricing escalation thread and confirm if Finance needs a formal credit memo?
- Grace: please sanity-check the support ticket impact noted in column H.

I want to close any ambiguity for the Friday forecast push. If Atlas is moving to a 0.75x renewal (or deferring), we need that flagged in the pipeline and in our mid-quarter variance deck.

Attachments: 20261110-atlasmech-renewal-snapshot.csv (snapshot of opportunity fields + risk tags) and a copy of the last signed MA.

Thanks — OLGA
Olga Petrov
Director, Renewals (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Weekly Renewal Snapshot + Mid-Quarter Churn Triage

Olga —

Quick update after checking the account and recent CS notes: committed ARR remains listed as $420k in HubSpot, but CS logged two incidents in Oct that pushed utilization down 33% for the key billing entity. I propose we move the opportunity to Commit:Watch and tag as "pricing_open" until Priyom confirms whether the discount request was formal.

I'll reach out to CS to confirm whether there were any planned scale-backs. If Atlas is asking for a smaller seat count, that becomes a revenue adjustment rather than a pure risk flag.

-Rishi
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Looping in quick notes from pricing ops: Atlas submitted an informal request for a 15% list discount last week via their CSM; no formal PO or amendment has been received. Finance flagged their ARR as "at risk" for discounts pending approval. If Atlas wants a permanent price change we need a signed amendment and a decision from RevOps on recognition treatment.

I'll open a ticket with RevOps today and cc Finance; expect an update by EOD Thursday. For now, agree with Rishi — mark as Commit:Watch.

- Priyom

From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@atlasmech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasMech Finance <finance@atlasmech.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly Renewal Snapshot + Mid-Quarter Churn Triage

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. To be transparent, Atlas is re-evaluating cloud spend for Q1 and we are considering reducing our contract scale by ~20% unless we can get additional value on the platform for our larger field ops teams. There was an internal procurement review and the finance lead asked us to revisit the license count.

We haven't submitted anything formal yet because we wanted to see if Redwood could propose options (credit, pilot expansion credits, or bundled pricing for field ops). Can you share any available short-term pilots or credits that might keep us at the current scale while we run a 30-day value pilot?

Best,
Lena Torres
Head of IT
Atlas Mechanical

Lena —

Appreciate the transparency. We can offer a 30-day field-ops pilot with up to 10 pilot seats at no charge and a one-time $15k credit if the pilot validates expansion back to current license levels within 60 days. Priyom — can you confirm this fits within the discount guardrails? I'll draft a short amendment + pilot SOW and share a DocuSign link.

Rishi/Grace: please set Atlas to Commit:AtRisk and note a provisional 0.8x renewal in the Friday forecast. I've attached the MA copy for legal to reference (AtlasMech_MA_signed_v2.pdf).

Next steps:
- Priyom: confirm approval for pilot credit or escalate to RevOps/Finance.
- Rishi: update HubSpot stage and expected renewal ARR to $336k (provisional).
- Grace: liaise with CS to schedule the pilot onboarding (target start 11/18).

I'll post the signed amendment & DocuSign link once legal confirms the SOW language.

Thanks — OLGA
Olga Petrov
Director, Renewals (Americas)
Redwood Inference
